zones.description: Ecological Cool Base (day): 13,053 km² in 2025 (24% of the study area), mean observed day anomaly -6.51 °C. Main warming drivers: Surface wetness (MNDWI) (+0.08 °C), Spring green-up (+0.04 °C), Built-up fraction (+0.03 °C). Main cooling drivers: Built-up index (NDBI) (-3.50 °C), Vegetation (NDVI) (-1.48 °C), Albedo (-0.67 °C). Largest shares in Muzaffarnagar (20%), Meerut (19%), Bulandshahr (19%).

recommendations.rationale: In the final day model, raising NDVI by 0.06 in every cell (zone median 0.38 → 0.45), i.e. greening within the existing land covers is associated with a mean LST change of -0.84 °C over the zone's 13,053 cells (95% CI -0.92 to -0.69 °C). The 3- and 15-cell neighbourhood means are recomputed (distances held fixed): 13,405 cells outside the zone have changed neighbourhood inputs (mean LST change -0.07 °C over them, cells whose prediction does not move included). This is a model-based ceteris-paribus estimate, not a causal effect. The target is the feasibility bound (the zone's own 90th/10th percentile, or the maximum step).

In the final day model, lowering cropland by 15 percentage points in every cell (zone median 98% → 83%) is associated with a mean LST change of -0.12 °C over the zone's 13,053 cells (95% CI -0.46 to +0.16 °C). The land is given to the other land covers (including other vegetation) in proportion to their shares, mostly built-up fraction (+11 pp) and tree cover (+2.9 pp); NDVI, spring NDVI, NDBI, MNDWI and albedo follow through the land-cover coupling. The 3- and 15-cell neighbourhood means are recomputed (distances held fixed): 13,405 cells outside the zone have changed neighbourhood inputs (mean LST change +0.01 °C over them, cells whose prediction does not move included).
